_note: The tax on employment (professional tax), deducted in full from salary where the regime allows it (D-093; rulebook SAL-PTAX-001, -002, H-13). The amount is the total of the SALARIES lines whose component feeds this row. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(1) Table Sl. 1 (p.41): "Sum paid by the assessee as a tax on employment as per article 276(2) of the Constitution, leviable by or under any law. — Entire amount."; not in the new regime, s.202(2)(a)(iv) (p.227): the total income is computed "without any exemption or deduction under— … (iv) section 19(1) (Table: Sl. No. 1)". Finance Act, 2026 (4 of 2026) searched in full: it does not amend s.19 or s.202. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.16(iii) (thc.nic.in, p.140; inserted by Act 13 of 1989 s.5, w.e.f. 1-4-1990): "a deduction of any sum paid by the assessee on account of a tax on employment within the meaning of clause (2) of article 276 of the Constitution, leviable by or under any law"; not in the new regime, s.115BAC(2)(i) as substituted by Finance Act, 2023 s.52 (p.34), which lists "clause (ii) or clause (iii) of section 16". The row applies in every regime; the new regime forbids it through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (D-165), so the exclusion is explained by its provision.
